title: Darling Ingredients Inc. Closes on Sale of CTH Sausage Casings Business
summary: Darling Ingredients announced that we will host a conference call on Thursday, Oct. 29, 2026, at 9 a.m. Eastern Time to discuss third quarter 2026 financial results…
body_markdown:
Darling Ingredients Inc. (NYSE: DAR) closed on the sale of its CTH branded sausage casing business to SARIA for an undisclosed amount.


“The sale of CTH illustrates our continued commitment to optimizing our portfolio and positioning Darling Ingredients for continued growth,” said[Randall C. Stuewe](https://www.darlingii.com/about/management/randall-c-stuewe) , Chairman and Chief Executive Officer. “We are committed to channeling our efforts toward segments with strong integration and long-term value creation potential, while using the proceeds to further our goal of reducing debt.
